description.zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。
智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流

1 - 智能体优先理解Camera流；

2 - 智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流。
description.en:
If video understanding is enabled, this parameter specifies which video stream the agent processes. Since the agent can only process one stream at a time, this setting determines the priority when both the camera and screen sharing streams are active.

`1`: The agent prioritizes the camera stream.

`2`: The agent prioritizes the screen sharing stream.

By default, the camera stream is prioritized.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The limit for this API is 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. Exceeding this limit triggers API call throttling, which can impact your business.
